name: Texas Science Bowl
notes: 62 teams in two 5-round Swiss groups (Jester/Kins, stage rr) plus the 31-game DE bracket (Ward Melville 1 beat Amador Valley in the second final). Player stats cover the Swiss rounds only (Games/TUH/PPG/NPG per subject, no energy); points, negs and corrects follow exactly from PPG and NPG times games, and players split into two MODAQ rows are summed. The stats team 'Will of A' is ASFA (same PPG and players); hidden per-game MODAQ tabs were not used.
